title: Role Transition (master/conductor/performer)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: role-transition.ts 实现 master/conductor/performer 状态机
AC-2: session_start.sh 启动时验证 role, 必要时 transition
AC-3: kallax role:transition <from> <to> --reason <why> CLI (带 audit log)
AC-4: transition 需要 auditor+ role 权限
AC-5: transition 记录审计日志 (from_role, to_role, reason, actor, timestamp)
AC-6: 无效 transition (e.g., performer → master) 被拒绝
AC-7: TTL 自动 expire (delegation TTL 实现)
AC-8: break-glass transition ≤ 1h TTL + 全 audit
AC-9: L1 存在性: ls src/permissions/role-transition.ts
AC-10: L2 实质性: wc -c role-transition.ts > 400 bytes
AC-11: L3 接线正确: npx tsc --noEmit 无错误
AC-12: L4 数据流动: 模拟跨 role transition, 验证审计 + 权限变更
AC-13: 循环继承检测 (A inherits B, B inherits A → reject)
